channel.title: noyalib: Enterprise-Grade Data & YAML Engine for Rust, WebAssembly & AI
channel.description: noyalib is an enterprise-grade data & YAML engine written in 100% safe Rust featuring zero-copy SIMD parsing, parallel Rayon streaming, WebAssembly runtime, Model Context Protocol (MCP) AI server, and LSP support.
